source.title: A Review of Governance and Accountability in the Regionalization of Health Services
source.publisher: Office of the Auditor General of British Columbia
source.cartographyCredit: Ministry of Health and Ministry Responsible for Seniors

statusDefinitions.matched_abbreviated_name: Short map geographic name corresponds to a repository body; this is not a geometry validation.
statusDefinitions.matched_historical_alias: A historical map label corresponds to an earlier name in the repository identity history.
statusDefinitions.matched_historical_alias_date_discrepanc: Body identity matched; source and repository use different dates for a documented name change and the discrepancy is preserved.
statusDefinitions.related_geography_unresolved: A related repository body is identified, but legal identity/status equivalence to the map label is unresolved; no definitive repoBodyId is assigned.

globalCautions: These maps document the 1997 restructuring as published in the 1997/98 report. They are not certified here as exact boundaries on 11 December 2001.
Councils and societies served different types of care; their areas overlap. Do not dissolve all three categories into one set of mutually exclusive authorities.
Map artwork is in document page coordinates. No projection, coordinates, datum, GIS geometry, or historical boundary accuracy is established by the vector PDF.
Original source names and numbers are preserved; repository IDs are stable links to identity histories, not replacements for historical labels.
Nisga’a map number 32 is related geography only until the legal identity/status difference is resolved.
North Okanagan date discrepancy: report says 12 September 1997; repository records the order-made date of 3 September 1997 and states deposit date is unrecovered.
